name: Erg
author: E. T. Carter
description: Moonlit dunes: a sea of sinuous, rippled dune ridges runs to a flat horizon under a low mottled moon in a wine sky, crests edged in rose light and steep lee faces sunk in blue-black shadow, with fine sand combed off every crest in moving streamers. The view drifts slowly over the ridges toward the moon.

params.label: Wind
params.effect: How much sand streams off the crests and how fast the grains skim past.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the slow drift over the dunes.

params.label: Moonlight
params.effect: Brightness of the moon and the light on the windward slopes.
